    # 1984

    # 1985

    # 1987 (Jan-Mar)
    79, 76, 110
]

print(f"Number of months: {len(outlays)}")
print(f"Values: {outlays}")

# Calculate geometric mean
product = 1
for v in outlays:
    product *= v
    
geometric_mean = product ** (1/len(outlays))
print(f"\nGeometric mean: {geometric_mean}")

# In millions (already in millions from the data)
# Round to nearest thousandth
rounded = round(geometric_mean, 3)
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {rounded}")
EOF
